featured_reviews.name: Neha Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
As I bring this chapter of my fitness journey to a close, I want to express my deepest gratitude for everything I’ve experienced over the past year.

First and foremost, thank you to my sister Vidya — she was the one who introduced me to this gym and encouraged me to take the first step. I’ll always be grateful to her for setting me on this path.

When I started my journey with Womentain, it wasn’t easy. I struggled with posture, steps, aasan, and stamina. Every day I cried at home, but I never gave up.
Slowly, with patience, persistence, and the incredible support of each one of you, I pushed through those challenges — and it changed my life.

There were times we fought for space, equipment, and even the mirror, but honestly, I loved every bit of it — especially our fun gossip sessions that made the tough days easier and the journey more joyful.

Today, I stand 15 kg lighter —  but more importantly, I feel stronger, healthier, and more confident.

A heartfelt thank you to my
CrossFit trainer – Supriya,
Yoga trainer – Jabin,
Zumba trainer – Swamini,
Aerobics trainer – Jaya,
Receptionist – Anita.
Your guidance, energy, and motivation made every session count, and your warm support made the gym feel like home.

Special thanks to Anita Ma’am, our Principal — from you, I learned the importance of posture and that “age is just a number.” You are a true inspiration.

As they say, *“कहीं पहुँचने के लिए कहीं से निकलना ज़रूरी होता है।”*
This may be the end of this chapter, but it’s just the beginning of a new one. The lessons, memories, and strength I’ve gained here will always stay with me.

With heartfelt gratitude, *Neha Kini*

featured_reviews.name: shrutee rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
The best HYROX training club!

It’s been almost 3 years since I started my fitness journey at Wayam Fitness Studio under the guidance of Wilson Gomes and Praveena. My cardio fitness and overall muscle strength have improved tremendously, and I’ve seen major positive changes in my health.
Last year, I completed my first HYROX race,  all thanks to their dedicated 3 months training plan, constant motivation, and personal attention. They truly push you to become your best.

Wayam feels like a second home with an amazing vibe that keeps you consistent and motivated.

One of the best decisions I’ve made for my health. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Ganesh Subramanian
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had trained at WAYAM Fitness Studio for about 6 months a couple of years ago, and even today, it remains one of the most positive fitness experiences I’ve had—largely thanks to Coach Wilson Gomes.

Coach Wilson Gomes is extremely knowledgeable, approachable, and genuinely invested in his clients’ progress. He always emphasized correct form, consistency, and building a strong foundation rather than chasing quick results. That approach not only helped me improve physically but also built long-term discipline and confidence in my fitness journey.

The environment at the studio was very motivating and supportive. Unlike many gyms, there was no intimidation—just a positive space where everyone could focus on improving at their own pace.

Even today, I still follow many of the techniques and habits I learned under his guidance, which speaks volumes about the quality of coaching.

I would highly recommend WAYAM Fitness Studio, especially Coach Wilson Gomes, to anyone looking for genuine training, proper guidance, and sustainable fitness results.

featured_reviews.name: Shrutika Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined Wayam just for a change of environment—and here, I found my vibe.

The energy, the people, the dedication and top of that coaches like Praveena and Wilson are the soul of the grind.

As we are training for the upcoming Hyrox Mumbai competition, Wayam has become more than just a gym. Now, I look forward to 8 PM more than anything else in my day because that’s Wayam  o’clock.

The credit goes to Praveena and Wilson, whose dedication, knowledge, and no-excuses attitude have pushed us to new levels.
Praveena genuinely cares about our progress and makes sure we show up as our best self, every day.

Trust me, Wayam is the vibe, and I’m proud to be part of it.

Don't miss the Friday sessions! They introduce new techniques every week that keep the energy high and the workouts evolving."

Highly recommended for anyone serious about their fitness journey."

featured_reviews.review_text: Been to multiple gyms in Vasai, but Wayam is on a whole different level. I couldn’t do a single push-up earlier, and now I can do burpees with ease. The best part is the workouts never get boring—every day brings something new, so nothing feels repetitive. Amazing vibe, great energy, and it constantly pushes you to give your best. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Venissa Furtado
featured_reviews.review_text: Working out at *Total Fitness* has been an amazing experience! It was recommended to me by my partner who himself has been a part of it since past few years. The gym area is decent and well-occupied. It has all the basic equipments required. It is cleaned and maintained well from time to time. It has separate washroom facility for men and women. Drinking water and Locker facility is available too. I train here about 5-6 days a week and find the consistent positive trainers, awesome music and participants who create a perfect workout environment. The trainers here are upbeat, knowledgeable, very professional, well-qualified and friendly. They take good interest in you no matter what fitness level you’re at. The workouts led by personal trainers give hands on instant feedback and adjustments during the workouts and just the right amount of encouragement. I have completed 3 months here and can already see great changes in my energy levels and body. A special shout out to one of the trainers (Mr. Abdul Memon). He has always been very welcoming and kind. The gym is less crowded around 9am and 3pm. But when crowded one has to do a bit waiting for the required machine, since, except elliptical and treadmill the other machines are only one in number. The parking space is little and sometimes vehicles have to be kept alongside the road. Being said that I genuinely feel that the overall vibe here is great and I have had nothing but good experiences. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Chat
featured_reviews.review_text: I joined this yoga class 7 months ago, and it has truly been a life-changing experience for me. What makes this class special is that it never follows just one routine—every day brings new and thoughtfully planned exercises. The sessions are personalized according to each person’s needs, which makes a huge difference. The guidance and attention given by Sir ensure that everyone improves at their own pace. Since joining, I have noticed remarkable changes in my flexibility, strength, and overall health. I feel more energetic, confident, and mentally relaxed. This class has not only improved my physical fitness but also brought positivity and balance into my daily life. I am genuinely grateful to be a part of it.

featured_reviews.name: Sunitha Suresh
featured_reviews.review_text: It has been roughly a month and a half since I started my journey at Fitnest Studio family, and the physical and mental shifts have been remarkable. While many approach yoga for weight loss, my primary goal was to gain a flexible and strong body.and this Fitnest studio has delivered exactly that.I’ve noticed a visible difference in my functional strength, particularly in my hands and legs. This one hour is a wonderful experience for me and it reduced my laziness.If anyone is looking for a place that treats yoga as a serious strength-building discipline rather than just a relaxation class, Fitnest Studio  is the place to be.

featured_reviews.name: pooja sonawane
featured_reviews.review_text: I truly enjoyed the yoga class. The instructor explained each pose clearly and made sure everyone was comfortable. The environment was peaceful, and the session helped me improve my flexibility and focus. It’s a great way to start the day with positivity!

featured_reviews.name: Keshav Maheshwari
featured_reviews.review_text: The workout is properly put up for a beginner, the workout includes Yoga, Power Yoga and Arerobics. The Coach Khan is very humble and pushes us to move beyond our limits. The best thing about the place is that it has  a cat which roams around when we are doing out workout. The place is open from Monday to Friday and has a lot of batches so you don't have to worry as in my case I wanted a batch from 4-5pm.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Tambe
featured_reviews.review_text: Great experience training here! The trainer is very knowledgeable, supportive, and always motivates me to push my limits. Workouts are well-planned and effective. Highly recommended for anyone serious about fitness!

featured_reviews.name: Shamal Chugh
featured_reviews.review_text:
**“Fitness Breath and Glow” **

featured_reviews.name: Rutvi Choudhari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently joined NextGen Fitness and it has been a great experience so far. The gym has a very welcoming and positive environment, with good quality equipment. The overall atmosphere is motivating and welcoming which makes it a comfortable place to work out.

A special mention to trainer Harsh, who is very helpful, and always available to guide whenever needed. Overall, it's a great gym with a supportive team and a good workout environment. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Deepali Deokar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I commenced my fitness journey 6 months back with NextGen fitness. Never did I knew that this journey would have been so transformative.

The modern equipments, the cleanliness, hygiene maintained is top notch. Pure motivation for a newbie like me to hit the gym on regular basis.

I availed an option of Personal training and got an excellent opportunity to train from Ravi Sir. His motivation and dedication towards transformation of clients is unmatchable and unbeatable. He really helps me push my limits and give my best. His expertise in the field and constant knowledge sharing related to fitness is truly motivating. This has helped in maintaining my strength and setting new bars each time.

featured_reviews.name: Avinash Sinagar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been thoroughly impressed with the standards and atmosphere at NextGen Fitness. The facility is exceptionally well-maintained, offering a wide range of modern equipment that caters to both beginners and seasoned fitness enthusiasts. The layout is thoughtfully designed, ensuring a smooth flow and comfortable workout environment.
The trainers and staff stand out for their professionalism and expertise. They provide personalized guidance, motivate members to push their limits safely, and foster a welcoming community spirit. Whether it’s strength training, cardio, or specialized fitness programs, the support is consistent and results driven.
Cleanliness and hygiene are clearly prioritized, with regular sanitization and well-kept amenities. The gym also offers flexible membership options and value-added services that make it a reliable choice for anyone serious about their health and fitness journey.

I’ve had the privilege of training under the personal trainer at Gym Ravi, and the experience has been nothing short of transformative. His approach combines professionalism, deep knowledge of fitness, and genuine care for his clients’ progress.
What Stands Out
- Personalized Programs: He tailors workouts to individual goals, whether it’s strength building, weight management, or overall fitness.
- Attention to Technique: Every session emphasizes correct form and posture, ensuring safety while maximizing results.
- Motivation & Discipline: His energy is contagious—he pushes you just enough to break limits without overwhelming you.
- Holistic Guidance: Beyond workouts, he shares valuable tips on nutrition, recovery, and lifestyle habits.
- Consistency & Reliability: Always punctual, prepared, and committed to helping clients achieve measurable progress.
My Experience
I’ve noticed significant improvements in stamina, strength, and confidence since starting with him. What I appreciate most is his ability to balance encouragement with accountability—he makes you want to show up and give your best every single time.

Overall, NextGen Fitness combines top-notch facilities, skilled trainers, and a positive environment, making it one of the most dependable fitness destinations in the area.

featured_reviews.name: Praveen Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been training at this gym for the past few months, and the experience has been excellent. The atmosphere is positive, the equipment is well maintained, and the staff are always friendly and helpful.

A special thanks to my trainer Ravi Khadse, who is highly professional and brings over 25 years of experience in the fitness industry. He is also a qualified dietitian, so the guidance goes beyond workouts.

I would highly recommend this gym and especially the trainer to anyone looking for expert fitness coaching along with professional dietary guidance.

featured_reviews.name: Hüśšãïñâ Mâštër
featured_reviews.review_text:
Just joined this gym and I'm already obsessed! 🔥 The equipment is top-notch, the place is spotless, and the vibe is super motivating. Definitely the right choice for my fitness journey 💪 But what really gets me is the vibe: motivating, positive, and not a single judgmental stare 😂. featured_reviews.name: Prajisha Siji
featured_reviews.review_text:
NextGen Training Center has an excellent ambience with a clean, spacious, and well-maintained gym. The equipment is modern, well-organized, and suitable for people of all fitness levels. A special mention to the personal trainer Devendra sir who is highly knowledgeable, professional, and dedicated. He  pays close attention to individual fitness goals, provides proper guidance on exercise techniques, and constantly motivates clients to achieve their best results. His  personalized approach and commitment to fitness make a significant difference in the overall training experience.
Thank you so much Devendra sir for your motivation and support.
I highly recommend this personal trainer to anyone looking for expert coaching, personalized attention, and outstanding support in reaching their fitness goals

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Borana
featured_reviews.review_text:
Really happy with my experience at this gym so far. The place is clean, well-maintained, and has all the equipment you’d need for a good workout.

Big shoutout to my trainer, Hussain sir. He’s extremely knowledgeable and pays close attention to form and technique. He’s patient, motivating, and always pushes you just enough to improve without overdoing it.

I’ve started noticing improvements in my strength and overall fitness since training under him. If you’re serious about getting results, I’d definitely recommend training with Hussain sir.

featured_reviews.name: Janvi Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello everyone,

I have had a wonderful experience at this gym. The trainers are supportive, the equipment is modern and well-maintained, and the gym is always clean and hygienic. The interiors are spacious, comfortable, and create a very positive workout environment.

I would especially like to appreciate my trainer, Ravi. He is an excellent trainer who is always motivating and encouraging. He pays close attention to every exercise and makes sure that our form and posture are correct to avoid injuries and get the best results. Whenever we make a mistake, he patiently corrects us and guides us properly.

Ravi also motivates us to stay consistent with our workouts and gives helpful diet and fitness tips. His positive attitude and dedication make every workout session enjoyable and effective.

I would happily give this gym a 5-star rating and highly recommend it to anyone looking to improve their fitness. Thank you to Ravi and the entire team for their support and encouragement.
